info.title: FreightClaw 机器接入 API
info.description: 由当前代码和JSON Schema生成。统一应用 Key 可直接调用固定 REST 路由，也可换取 MCP 短令牌；网页使用邮箱账号密码。正式报价保存、人工审核和PDF是人员授权业务操作，不在机器凭证中隐式开放。

DomainCommon.title: Cross-border Logistics MCP shared schema definitions

DecimalString.description: Decimal value encoded as a string; never a binary float.

RatioString.description: Ratio in the closed interval [0, 1], encoded as a decimal string.

data.description: Tool-specific object validated by the tool contract, or null when no result is safe to expose.

DomainQuoteEnvelopeV2.title: AI 报价 v2 response envelope

data.description: v2 quote result or null when no result is safe to expose.

allOf.$comment: 仅作 quote_status refinement；v2 $ref 已封闭对象，allOf 合并后仍不接受未知字段。

oneOf.$comment: manual_review + data=null 仅用于零调用业务门禁；不得伪造报价、发布或来源证据。
